title: Ghar par sab ko laga, sab theek hai
banner:
Naukri gayi, par ghar par
'sab badhiya hai' 😶
caption:
Rohan ne kisi ko nahi bataya. Phir ek raat, bina naam ke, likh diya. 👇
Ek sach, bina naam ke: Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a young man who loses his job and tells his family everything is fine, until he finds one place to say the truth without his name. Waypoint is free on Google Play, for adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Rohan: Rohan is a 27-year-old Indian man with short black hair, a light stubble, a plain blue shirt and a backpack; an honest tired face.
cast.Maa: Maa is Rohan's mother, a kind Indian woman in her fifties in a green cotton saree, hair in a bun, reading glasses on a chain.
cast.fox: The fox mascot is a friendly small orange fox with big kind eyes and a teal scarf, standing on two legs like a storybook character.

scenes.vo: रोहन की नौकरी चली गई, एक सोमवार को।
scenes.sub: Rohan ki naukri chali gayi, ek Somvaar ko.
scenes.art: Rohan walks out of a glass office building on a grey morning carrying a small cardboard box with a plant and a mug, other people rushing past him, his face blank and tired.

scenes.vo: शाम को माँ का फ़ोन, काम कैसा चल रहा है?
scenes.sub: Shaam ko Maa ka phone: 'kaam kaisa chal raha hai?'
scenes.art: Rohan sits by the window of a crowded city bus at dusk holding his phone to his ear, forcing a small smile while his eyes look sad, city lights blurring outside.
Close view of Rohan's face lit by his phone in a dim rented room, a cheerful fake smile on his lips and worry in his eyes, the cardboard box from the office still unopened on the floor.

scenes.vo: दोस्तों के ग्रुप में, सबकी तरक्की की ख़बरें।
scenes.sub: Doston ke group mein, sabki tarakki ki khabrein.
scenes.art: Rohan lies on his bed at night scrolling his phone, floating chat bubbles around him show confetti, a trophy, a new car and a 'promoted!' badge, his own face dull in the blue light.

scenes.vo: कहता किसे? सबको लगता है, सब ठीक है।
scenes.sub: Kehta kise? Sabko lagta hai, sab theek hai.
scenes.art: Rohan alone on the roof of a city building at night, sitting on the parapet with his knees drawn up, a sea of lit windows below, a dark sky with a few stars.

scenes.vo: फिर उसने वेपॉइंट खोला। न नाम, न चेहरा।
scenes.sub: Phir usne Waypoint khola. Na naam, na chehra.

scenes.vo: आज मेरी नौकरी चली गई। किसी को नहीं बताया।
scenes.sub: 'Aaj meri naukri chali gayi. Kisi ko nahi bataya.'

scenes.vo: कुछ ही देर में अनजानों ने कहा, हम सुन रहे हैं।
scenes.sub: Kuch hi der mein anjaanon ne kaha: 'hum sun rahe hain.'
scenes.art: Rohan's phone glows in his hands in the dark room, three soft glowing hearts and hands float up from the screen and light his surprised face, the fox mascot peeks over the edge of the bed.

scenes.vo: एक ने लिखा, मेरी भी गई थी। बाद में बेहतर मिली।
scenes.sub: Ek ne likha: 'meri bhi gayi thi. Baad mein behtar mili.'
scenes.art: A single glowing message card floats above Rohan's phone like a paper lantern in the dark room, Rohan reads it with his hand over his mouth, eyes wet, a faint warm light on his face.

scenes.vo: उस रात, रोहन पहली बार चैन से सोया।
scenes.sub: Us raat, Rohan pehli baar chain se soya.
scenes.art: Rohan asleep peacefully in his small room, the phone face down on the bedside table, moonlight through the window, the fox mascot curled up asleep on the windowsill.

scenes.vo: अगली सुबह, उसने माँ को सच बताया।
scenes.sub: Agli subah, usne Maa ko sach bataya.
scenes.art: Rohan on a small sunny balcony in the morning holding a cup of tea and his phone to his ear, an honest open face, a deep breath, pigeons on the railing.

scenes.vo: माँ बोलीं, बेटा, तू है, तो सब है।
scenes.sub: Maa bolin: 'Beta, tu hai, to sab hai.'
scenes.art: Maa in a green saree standing in her small kitchen holding the phone to her ear with a tearful proud smile, steam from a pot behind her, morning light through the window.

scenes.vo: आपकी वो एक बात, जो आपने किसी को नहीं बताई?
scenes.sub: Aapki woh ek baat, jo aapne kisi ko nahi batayi?
